_: lab/camera_moves (plan/2026-11-20d §6): each run's clips as the lab briefed them, in the shape facts.clip_facts gives the gates, and gpt-6.1-sol's answer from that run.

clips.movement: one slow pan right revealing the separation between Dinu and Rohan
clips.angle: eye level from beneath a tarpaulin edge
clips.why: Gives the recognition singles a shared lane and visible separation, using rain and occluded market edges without sharply resolving passing shoppers.
clips.summary: From beneath a tarpaulin edge, a short pan reveals Dinu threading rightward through the rainy market and Rohan standing across the lane with his torch low in his right hand. The few distant shoppers stay indistinct.

clips.why: Restricted handheld visibility makes Dinu vulnerable within the lane rather than heroic above it.
clips.summary: From the lane's near side, Dinu threads wet stalls with the box held beneath his jacket; rain dominates.

clips.why: A restrained tremor lets recognition land on Rohan without a decorative push.
clips.summary: Across the lane, Rohan fixes on Dinu; the tight view holds the recognition over rain.

clips.why: The same side of Rohan preserves the recognition-to-challenge connection.
clips.summary: Rohan projects L1 across the market to stop Dinu, in a tight three-quarter view above the rain.

clips.movement: short handheld drift parallel to his route
clips.why: Scrambling lateral coverage gives the flight weight while avoiding staged bodily collisions.
clips.summary: Dinu bolts right through a narrow gap in the market, guarding the concealed box as wet shoes strike the road.

clips.why: Separate physical contact from travel so the collision has a clear cause and one manageable action.
clips.summary: Beside the upright orange cart, Dinu's right palm drives against its upper rail while his left arm protects the box.

clips.why: Isolate the cart's tipping as the consequence of the preceding impact, avoiding multi-object choreography around a running body.
clips.summary: A close low view shows the struck wooden cart tip sideways and oranges spill onto the wet road with a wooden crash.

clips.why: One shared frame proves the pursuit distance after the impact without extra collision choreography.
clips.summary: Beyond the fallen cart, Dinu runs right with Rohan several paces behind, the torch still in Rohan's right grip.

clips.angle: road level across the escape route
clips.why: The must insert handles the cart tipping; this separate low aftermath lets the oranges briefly measure the disturbance after the men have passed.
clips.summary: At road level, oranges already scattered beside the tipped cart fill the foreground. One continues rolling and settles while running footfalls recede off frame.

clips.movement: short handheld drift parallel to his route
clips.why: The lateral passage carries the rightward chase into the constricted alley.
clips.summary: Dinu runs right into the narrow alley, the box still concealed against his left side, with hurried footfalls and rain.

clips.why: A low view makes the vulnerable footing and recovery legible without treating the slip as a stunt.
clips.summary: Dinu's shoe slides on wet alley stones; he catches his balance while keeping the hidden box against his ribs.

clips.why: A side view establishes the vertical escape and Rohan's following distance in one readable axis.
clips.summary: Dinu climbs the iron stairs toward the roof with the box beneath his jacket; Rohan follows from the alley below with his torch.

clips.why: A tight, almost still handheld frame makes the tank feel like a fragile barrier.
clips.summary: On the roof, Dinu crouches behind a water tank and struggles to quiet his breathing while clutching the concealed box.

clips.why: The search gains a clear physical source while the tank preserves the spatial separation.
clips.summary: From the far side of the tank, Rohan sweeps his torch across it, pauses the beam, then moves the light on.

clips.why: The light's departure and receding steps are measured against Dinu's face, not an invented pursuit beat.
clips.summary: Dinu stays crouched as the torch light moves off the tank; the footsteps recede and his breathing remains audible.

clips.angle: low grazing angle along the tank wall
clips.why: Isolates the beam's pause as a physical threat on the tank wall, giving the editor a suspense detail rather than another face or search medium.
clips.summary: A tight low view of the wet tank wall catches the torch beam already paused on its surface. The beam travels right and leaves darkness; rain and rooftop footfalls continue off frame.

clips.why: A steady unobstructed view makes the absence inside the box unmistakable.
clips.summary: Crouched behind the tank, Dinu opens the dented metal box in his lap; its interior is empty.

clips.angle: eye level, three-quarter from the pursuit-axis side
clips.why: The opening insert establishes absence; this isolated face makes its consequence readable before L6 without repeating the hands or reopening the box.
clips.summary: An extreme close view isolates Dinu behind the rooftop tank. His eyes remain on the open box below frame and his jaw loosens as rain and uneven breathing continue.

clips.why: A close face lets the empty-box discovery turn into the whispered question without melodramatic movement.
clips.summary: Dinu looks into the empty box and voices L6, wondering where the missing thing is, as the rain continues.

clips.movement: one slow rising crane retreat away from Dinu, remaining on the established side of the pursuit axis
clips.angle: elevated oblique view from the established camera side
clips.why: Releases the final close single into spatial isolation after L6, making the concealed shelter feel large around the man and the useless box.
clips.summary: After L6, an elevated camera retreats from Dinu crouched behind the tank with the open box in his lap. He remains still as more rain-wet rooftop surrounds him.

answer.camera_language: Handheld-motivated travel keeps the market crowded and physical; movement contracts around the tank, drives into the empty box at the turn, then rises away into isolation.
answer.arc: Watchfulness at 2 rises through pursuit at 4, compresses into rooftop suspense, drops to a quiet 2 before the empty-box peak at 5, then releases into loss.

clips.direction: right across the lane toward Rohan
clips.trigger: Dinu threads rightward beneath the tarpaulin
clips.motivation: Connect the moving quarry to the stationary hunter without losing their separation.
clips.opens_on: Wide market lane beneath a soft tarpaulin edge, Dinu near left and Rohan near far right.
clips.lands_on: Wide lane with Rohan more prominent at right and Dinu still separated from him across the road.
clips.composition_note: The tarpaulin brackets the lane; preserve both men and the open distance between them.
clips.why: Establishing 2: a purposeful handheld pan maps hunter and quarry through the crowded foreground rather than relying on an invisible float.
clips.camera_sentence: In an eye-level wide view beneath the tarpaulin, pan slowly right as Dinu threads the lane, ending with Rohan prominent across the road and the distance between them visible.

clips.trigger: Dinu passes between the stall edges
clips.motivation: Keep his guarded torso readable while the moving stalls expose his vulnerability.
clips.opens_on: Dinu waist up left of centre, his left forearm pressed against his jacket.
clips.lands_on: Dinu waist up against a new stretch of wet stalls, still with space ahead to the right.
clips.composition_note: Keep Dinu left of centre and let nearby stall edges pass faster than the crowded background.
clips.why: Tension 2: actual handheld travel beside Dinu makes the market slide past his protected ribs instead of rendering as a static drift.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level waist-up view, move slowly right alongside Dinu as he threads the stalls, keeping him left of centre while foreground edges pass, ending waist up with room ahead.

clips.trigger: Rohan fixes his gaze screen left
clips.motivation: Convert recognition into predatory attention through a visible tightening.
clips.opens_on: Rohan's face in three-quarter close-up on the right, looking left.
clips.lands_on: A tighter close-up of Rohan's face with less space around his gaze.
clips.angle_reason: Looking slightly up gives the hunter authority before he calls out.
clips.composition_note: Retain leftward eyeline space even as the face grows larger.
clips.why: Threat 3: a measured handheld push turns Rohan's recognition into pressure, with a lower viewpoint establishing his advantage.
clips.camera_sentence: From a slightly low three-quarter close-up, push slowly toward Rohan as his gaze fixes left, ending on a tighter view of his face with a narrow strip of space ahead of his eyes.

clips.trigger: Rohan begins L1
clips.motivation: Make the public command bear down on Dinu without disturbing the speaking face.
clips.opens_on: Rohan chest up at right in three-quarter view, eyeline open to the left.
clips.lands_on: Rohan's face in close-up, maintaining the same leftward eyeline.
clips.angle_reason: Match setup B's lower viewpoint so his command continues the established dominance.
clips.composition_note: Keep his full three-quarter face readable and preserve the leftward address.
clips.why: Confrontation 4: a slow, visible handheld push strengthens the command while protecting lip readability and matching the preceding movement.
clips.camera_sentence: From a slightly low chest-up view, push slowly toward Rohan as he calls across the lane, ending in a close-up of his three-quarter face with his leftward eyeline clear.

clips.direction: right beside Dinu toward the cart
clips.trigger: Dinu bolts through the gap
clips.motivation: Accelerate with his escape while keeping the protected box and approaching obstruction legible.
clips.opens_on: Dinu waist up at left with the cart edge ahead at right.
clips.lands_on: Dinu waist up beside the cart approach, stalls streaking past behind him.
clips.composition_note: Leave rightward space for the cart and keep his left arm unobscured.
clips.why: Pursuit 4: fast handheld travel replaces decorative tremor with a changing background and an unmistakable route toward impact.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level waist-up view, move rapidly right beside Dinu as he bolts through the gap, keeping space toward the cart and ending waist up near its approach.

clips.direction: toward Dinu's right palm and the cart rail
clips.trigger: Dinu drives his right palm against the rail
clips.motivation: Make the contact point, not a generalized jolt, carry the force of the escape.
clips.opens_on: Dinu waist up at left and the loaded cart at right, his palm clear of the upper rail.
clips.lands_on: Dinu chest up beside the rail, with his right palm and protected left side clearly visible.
clips.angle_reason: The lower viewpoint emphasizes the leverage he gets against the rail rather than heroic stature.
clips.composition_note: Place the palm-to-rail contact near the right third while retaining his guarded left ribs.
clips.why: Pursuit 4: a concrete handheld push settles on the mechanical cause of the cart's fall and lets the impact remain readable.
clips.camera_sentence: From a slightly low waist-up view, push closer as Dinu's palm meets the cart's upper edge, then settle on his chest, protected left side and right hand pressed against the wood.

clips.direction: right with the falling cart and spilling oranges
clips.trigger: The cart tips sideways
clips.motivation: Carry the force from the cart into the debris that now obstructs the route.
clips.opens_on: Low insert of the tilted loaded cart at left and wet road at right.
clips.lands_on: Low insert of oranges spreading across wet stones with the tipped cart at the left edge.
clips.angle_reason: Road height makes the falling wood and rolling fruit tangible hazards in the escape route.
clips.composition_note: Keep open road to the right for the spill to occupy.
clips.why: Pursuit 4: the handheld pan follows a specific physical consequence rather than adding an unmotivated impact shake.
clips.camera_sentence: In a ground-level close insert, pan right with the cart's sideways fall and spilling oranges, ending on fruit spreading over the wet stones with the fallen cart at the left edge.

clips.direction: right after both runners, then let Dinu leave
clips.trigger: Both men accelerate beyond the fallen cart
clips.motivation: Show the short pursuit distance while preserving Dinu's planned exit.
clips.opens_on: Medium-wide view of Dinu at right and Rohan several paces behind at left beyond the tipped cart.
clips.lands_on: Medium-wide view of Rohan continuing right after Dinu has left the frame.
clips.composition_note: Retain the cart low in frame and stop the pan early enough for Dinu to exit right at the planned beat.
clips.why: Pursuit 4: a handheld pan proves how close Rohan remains, then relinquishes Dinu rather than changing his exit.
clips.camera_sentence: In an eye-level medium-wide view, pan right as both men run beyond the fallen cart, then let them move through the frame, ending with Rohan following Dinu's rightward exit.

clips.direction: right with the last rolling orange
clips.trigger: The remaining moving orange slows among the scattered fruit
clips.motivation: Let residual motion measure the disturbance after the runners have gone.
clips.opens_on: Road-level insert of scattered oranges, one rolling right near centre.
clips.lands_on: Road-level insert of the same orange at rest among the others.
clips.angle_reason: Road height holds attention on the material aftermath rather than the absent runners.
clips.composition_note: Keep the moving orange near centre while stationary fruit supplies visible parallax.
clips.why: Transition 2: a small but purposeful handheld pan follows a real object to rest, slowing the rhythm without inventing action.
clips.camera_sentence: From a road-level close insert, pan slowly right with the last rolling orange as it loses speed, ending on the orange at rest among the scattered fruit.

clips.direction: right alongside Dinu into the alley
clips.trigger: Dinu runs from the alley mouth toward the stairs
clips.motivation: Compress the passing background from market clutter into enclosing walls.
clips.opens_on: Dinu waist up at left beside the alley mouth, the route open to the right.
clips.lands_on: Dinu waist up deeper in the alley with wet walls and the stair approach around him.
clips.composition_note: Preserve rightward travel and let the nearer wall crowd the frame without hiding his left arm.
clips.why: Pursuit 4: real handheld travel carries the established rightward movement into a visibly tighter space.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level waist-up view, move rapidly right alongside Dinu as he enters the alley, ending waist up between the enclosing walls near the stair approach.

clips.direction: with Dinu's sideways loss of balance and recovery
clips.trigger: Dinu's forward shoe slides
clips.motivation: React to his unstable weight rather than styling the slip as a weightless stunt.
clips.opens_on: Low side medium shot of Dinu centred between the wet alley walls.
clips.lands_on: Low side medium shot of Dinu balanced again, his left arm still guarding his ribs.
clips.angle_reason: The low side position makes his shifting weight loom over the slippery ground without granting control.
clips.composition_note: Use the alley walls as tight vertical boundaries and follow only the body's actual displacement.
clips.why: Pursuit 4: a body-motivated handheld reframe registers the slip and recovery without adding a separate shake or changing the fixed medium opening.
clips.camera_sentence: From a low side medium shot, reframe with Dinu's sideways loss of balance as his shoe slips, then steady as he recovers, ending on his balanced torso between the alley walls.

clips.direction: up and right along the iron stairs
clips.trigger: Dinu climbs above the lower stairway
clips.motivation: Follow the vertical escape while retaining Rohan's pressure at the bottom of the frame.
clips.opens_on: Medium-wide side view of Dinu on the lower stairs and Rohan approaching below left.
clips.lands_on: Medium-wide side view of Dinu higher on the stairs, with Rohan and the stair foot near the lower edge.
clips.angle_reason: The lower side view makes the steep escape route visible while Rohan occupies its threatening base.
clips.composition_note: Let the staircase diagonal lead up right; limit the tilt so the approaching hunter remains at the bottom.
clips.why: Pursuit 4: the handheld upward tilt follows earned elevation while preserving the geography and cost of escape.
clips.camera_sentence: From a slightly low medium-wide side view, tilt upward as Dinu climbs the iron stairs, ending with him higher at right and Rohan near the stair foot along the lower edge.

clips.trigger: Dinu tries to steady his breathing
clips.motivation: Close the remaining visual space around him as movement becomes dangerous.
clips.opens_on: Dinu chest up low left behind the tank, its surface filling the right foreground.
clips.lands_on: Dinu's face in close-up pressed against a larger expanse of tank edge.
clips.angle_reason: Looking down toward his crouched eyeline makes him vulnerable beneath the unseen searcher.
clips.composition_note: Keep the tank as a heavy right-hand obstruction and avoid opening a view around its far side.
clips.why: Tension 3: a visible handheld creep narrows his shelter while the slightly high setup reverses the hunter's earlier authority.
clips.camera_sentence: From a slightly high chest-up view beside the tank, creep very slowly toward Dinu as he steadies his breathing, ending on his face hemmed in by the tank's foreground edge.

clips.direction: toward Rohan and his raised torch
clips.trigger: Rohan starts sweeping the tank
clips.motivation: Increase the searcher's physical presence while the beam's pause remains uninterrupted.
clips.opens_on: Rohan waist up at right beyond the tank, raised torch directed left.
clips.lands_on: Rohan chest up with his raised torch and part of the tank still visible.
clips.angle_reason: The lower searcher angle sustains his power over the crouching Dinu.
clips.composition_note: Keep Rohan on the right and sufficient tank surface left to read the beam's pause and departure.
clips.why: Threat 4: a slow handheld push makes the armed search feel closer while leaving the practical beam's full progression legible.
clips.camera_sentence: From a slightly low waist-up view across the tank, push slowly toward Rohan as his torch sweeps and pauses, ending chest up with the raised torch and tank surface still visible.

clips.trigger: The torch patch starts moving off the tank edge
clips.motivation: Stay with his withheld relief until the receding footsteps make safety plausible.
clips.opens_on: Dinu chest up low left with the torch patch at the tank's far edge.
clips.lands_on: Dinu's face in close-up beside the dark tank edge.
clips.angle_reason: Match setup K's downward view of the crouching Dinu; he has not yet regained security.
clips.composition_note: Preserve the tank on the right and the same crouched eyeline as the earlier K shot.
clips.why: Tension 3: the handheld push settles rather than celebrating escape, making Dinu's reaction last as the light leaves.
clips.camera_sentence: From a slightly high chest-up view, push slowly toward Dinu as the torch patch leaves the tank, then settle on his face beside the dark edge.

clips.direction: fixed along the wet tank wall
clips.trigger: The torch patch is already paused on the wall
clips.motivation: Let the light leave an unmoving surface so its departure, rather than camera movement, creates the suspense.
clips.opens_on: Tight grazing insert of wet tank wall with a stationary torch patch near centre.
clips.lands_on: The same tight tank detail after the patch has travelled out right.
clips.angle_reason: A low grazing view places the audience near Dinu's hiding level and makes the tank a substantial barrier.
clips.composition_note: Keep the wall fixed so the patch visibly crosses and leaves the right edge.
clips.why: Tension 2: a deliberately held handheld position makes the departing beam measurable and creates a quiet pocket before the discovery, without relying on simulated tremor.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold a low, close grazing view along the wet tank wall as the torch patch travels right and leaves the frame, ending on the same dark, rain-streaked surface.

clips.direction: down the viewing line into the box interior
clips.trigger: Dinu begins lifting the lid
clips.motivation: Drive attention into the absence and remain there long enough for the failed purpose of the chase to register.
clips.opens_on: High three-quarter insert of the closed dented box in Dinu's lap and both hands.
clips.lands_on: Tighter insert with the empty interior filling the frame and supporting fingers at its edge.
clips.angle_reason: Look down along Dinu's inspection line so the entire empty cavity is unmistakable.
clips.composition_note: Maintain a clear view over the near rim and finish the push as the lid clears, holding the empty cavity through the remaining beat.
clips.why: Reveal 5: the scene's decisive handheld push lands inside the empty box and holds the absence, turning physical escape into a new mystery.
clips.camera_sentence: From a high three-quarter insert of the box, push decisively closer as the lid opens, then hold with the empty interior filling the frame and the supporting fingers at its edge.

clips.direction: fixed on Dinu's lowered eyes and mouth
clips.trigger: Dinu's jaw loosens as he looks into the box
clips.motivation: Let the consequence register without competing with an already extreme facial framing.
clips.opens_on: Extreme close-up of Dinu's three-quarter face, eyes lowered, tank edge blurred at left.
clips.lands_on: The same extreme close-up with his loosened jaw and lowered gaze unobstructed.
clips.angle_reason: Meet his crouched eyeline so the loss is witnessed directly rather than judged from above.
clips.composition_note: Do not tighten beyond the extreme close-up; retain both eyes and enough mouth to read the reaction.
clips.why: Realisation 4: a deliberately held handheld position breaks the preceding push so the important reaction remains on screen without ornamental motion.
clips.camera_sentence: Hold an eye-level extreme close-up at Dinu's crouched height as his jaw loosens, ending on the same isolated three-quarter face with his eyes lowered.

clips.direction: away from Dinu toward the surrounding tank
clips.trigger: Dinu begins the whispered question L6
clips.motivation: Let the unanswered question restore a little hostile space around the face without losing the whisper.
clips.opens_on: Dinu's face in three-quarter close-up, eyes lowered toward the box below frame.
clips.lands_on: Dinu chest up beside the tank, with more wet rooftop space around his shoulders.
clips.angle_reason: Stay at his crouched eyeline so the withdrawal expresses isolation rather than renewed threat.
clips.composition_note: Keep his full speaking face readable as a restrained amount of empty space returns beside him.
clips.why: Isolation 3: a slow handheld withdrawal keeps the whispered face readable while beginning the spatial release that the final wide completes.
clips.camera_sentence: From an eye-level close-up at crouched height, pull back slowly as Dinu whispers toward the box, ending chest up with the tank and more empty rooftop space around him.

clips.direction: up and away on the established camera side
clips.trigger: Dinu remains crouched over the open box after the question
clips.motivation: Make the shelter expand around a man whose escape has yielded nothing.
clips.opens_on: Elevated wide view of Dinu small at lower right behind the tank with the open box in his lap.
clips.lands_on: Extreme-wide high view of the rain-wet rooftop, Dinu smaller beside the tank.
clips.angle_reason: The rising viewpoint diminishes Dinu and turns the rooftop from shelter into empty surrounding space.
clips.composition_note: Keep Dinu lower right and remain on the established side while progressively revealing more roof around the tank.
clips.why: Isolation 4: the final rise deliberately leaves the production's close handheld language to make Dinu visibly small after the empty-box turn.
clips.camera_sentence: From an elevated wide view, rise slowly up and away as Dinu remains over the open box, ending in an extreme-wide view with him small beside the tank amid the wet rooftop.

clips.why: Places the men within the enclosing rain-bound garage before the handheld coverage narrows attention to the box; provides a clean temporal-caption option.
clips.summary: A fixed wide view from the garage entrance frames Nimal at left with the closed box and Dinu at right. Neither moves as rain strikes the roof; the temporal caption can be added in post.

clips.summary: An eye-level single holds Nimal through L2 as he identifies the money's owner, amount and alleged source.

clips.movement: Restrained handheld drift around a fixed composition

clips.movement: Restrained handheld drift around a fixed composition

clips.movement: Restrained handheld drift around a fixed composition

clips.why: Nimal's waiting face allows the editor to sustain the unresolved space without an invented decision.
clips.summary: Nimal watches Dinu study the key, holding the open box below frame as rain continues on the roof.
